text: Container outbound traffic (bytes a container sends that are not replies to visitors, e.g. calls to outside APIs): "we need to charge a little for this" — rate: "Cloudflare's cost + margin". Cost = Cloudflare container egress $0.025/GB (config dply.edge.usage_billing.container_outbound_millicents_per_gb), customer price = cost × (1 + margin_percent/100) through UsagePrice, like every non-fixed meter. Outbound = container tx_bytes minus the reply bytes the container Worker counted, per app per day, never below zero. (Owner answers, 2026-09-29.)
